violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. PIC was not able to provide Certified Food Manager certification.
violations.corrective_action: Please obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program before a follow-up inspection. A follow-up inspection will be conducted within 10 days.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: Dishwashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of 0ppm chlorine. The dish-ware is not properly sanitized.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC discontinued use the dish machine and set up 3 compartment sink for properly sanitizing dish-ware. PIC properly sanitized the dish-ware.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed cooked white rice in hot holding cabinet Alto-Shaam at 116-118F that had been held for 1 hr.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC reheated cooked white rice to 165F and placed it in a hot holding unit that was maintaining a temperature of 135F of above.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed ladles in use stored in a water container at the cook line with the water temperature at 84F
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS instructed PIC on proper storage of food utensils in food preparation area. PIC removed ladles from the water container and properly cleaned and sanitized them. MEZEH MEDITERRANEAN GRILL (Inspection Date: 07/22/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: DOK Employee Health Policy
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide a verbal or written policy for preventing the transmission of foodborne disease by an employee who has a disease or a medical condition. EHS provided a copy of Employee Health Policy, PIC had employees read and sign the policy.
violations.corrective_action: The person in charge or certified food manager is responsible for knowledge, of at least the primary foodborne diseases (the Big 6) and medical conditions, to determine possible restriction or exclusion of food employees.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS provided a copy of vomit &diarrhea written procedures to the PIC.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety foods are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours: OBSERVED COOKED LENTILS IN 2-DOOR UNDER-COUNTER COOLER AT 88F THAT WAS PREPARED APPROXIMATELY 3 HOURS PRIOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC DISCARDED LENTILS DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED CHICKEN AT 115F, PULLED LAMB AT 119F, AND STEAK AT 115F IN STEAM TABLE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC REHEATED ALL FOODS TO 165F DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS THAT THE WATER IN THE STEAM TABLE SHOULD BE FILLED HIGHER TO ENSURE THAT THE FOODS STAY AT 135F OR ABOVE AT ALL TIMES.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED COUSCOUS AT 51F AND DICED TOMATOES AND CUCUMBERS AT 47F IN LEFT SERVICE LINE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. COLD HOLDING UNIT WAS TURNED OFF; PIC TURNED ON UNIT DURING INSPECTION WHICH WAS SET TO 32F. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD-HOLDING FOODS MUST BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. OBSERVED THREE VAT SINK MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 102F.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. PLEASE ENSURE THAT THE THREE VAT SINK CAN MEET 110F BY THE TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.
